saved mask comes from /tmp/main2.py (C9 code2 = C7 main.py plus writing), run in C10. It reads the region slice loaded in C6 and computes per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds for days of year 138–259. Those days feed the 31-day wrapped smoothing for target days of year 153–244, so pools cover 12 May–20 Sep of each baseline year. The thresholds are compared against all 92 target days per sea cell, then hot-run detection and gap joining produce the mask; the climatology is unused."}
